observable_failure_step.description: Observed FILE_WRITTEN producing Chapter 4 deliverable files in 03_deliverables directory

root_cause_diagnosis: The academic-writer agent generated Chapter 4 artifacts containing unaligned (unjustified) narrative paragraphs, bold table captions, numerical values lacking Persian leading zeros, non-RTL table cell directions, untranslated English words in Persian tables, and tables inside text where prose-only formatting was required, directly violating APA 7 formatting norms and specific OpenXML directives.
prescribed_behavior: When executing 'write_to_file' for Persian Academic artifacts, the agent must embed explicit <w:jc w:val='both'/> justification tags for prose, strip bold formatting from table captions in Markdown/OpenXML according to APA 7 rules, strictly enforce Persian leading zeroes (e.g. ۰.۰۵), and remove remaining English term leakage in Persian table cells.
